notes.title: Orphans 1.1 patch notes
notes.content: [p][b]Breaking Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][p]•	Game optimization has been improved.[/p][p]•	The design of the most confusing levels has been improved.[/p][p]•	Cinematic transitions are now smoother.[/p][p]•	A new game menu and a new language have been added.[/p][p]•	Minor bugs have been fixed.[/p][p]•	Minor sound issues have been fixed.[/p][p]•	Minor aesthetic changes.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][p][/p][p]•	A game load menu has been added, allowing players to resume the game from previous save points.  Information about collectibles obtained at each save point has also been added.[/p][p]•	A collectible counter HUD has been added, which appears above the character's head each time a collectible is found.[/p][p]•	Traditional Chinese has been added.[/p][p]•	Added a message: Are you sure...? when starting a new game.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][p][/p][p]•	Fixed the issue where pressing the button on the loading and credits screen did nothing.[/p][p]•	An issue with enemy spawning in the sewer has been fixed.[/p][p]•	A bug with the children in the final boss has been fixed.[/p][p]•	The error where children get stuck when passing through the hole in the barriers has been fixed.[/p][p]•	The error where the screen goes black when reaching the garden has been fixed.[/p][p]•	We fixed a bug with the police dog's behavior when chasing the dormouse girl.[/p][p]•	We fixed collisions in the prison.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][p][/p][p]•	Game optimization has been improved, and frame rates are now much more stable.[/p][p]•	The design of the most confusing levels, such as the cat's house and the prison, has been improved.[/p][p]•	The fade between music and sound has been improved.[/p][p]•	Cinematic transitions are now smoother.[/p][p]•	Level loading times have been improved.[/p][p]•	Feedback when finding graffiti has been improved.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Changes[/b][/p][p][/p][p]•	For keyboard use only: the default button for crouching has been changed from Left Control to Left Alt.[/p][p]•	Some extra save points have been added.[/p]

notes.title: Halloween update
notes.content:
Hello players! 

In this special Halloween update, Animal City's alleys have been covered, for a limited time, with the dark atmosphere of the holidays.

If you haven't played the Orphans demo yet, now is the time to immerse yourself in the terror of this dystopian city.

Orphans demo update 1.2

Aesthetic and gameplay improvements:

- Halloween decorations for the demo for a limited time.
- Design improvements in some sections of the game.
- New voices for Victoria
- Children appear in the main menu, after being saved.
- Added vibration to some actions taking control.
- Fixed visual errors with some particle effects.
- Fixed bugs with some translations.

Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Orphans Demo Update 1.1
notes.content:
Orphans Demo Update 1.1

Hi! We made several aesthetic and gameplay changes, welcoming feedback from you players. 

Aesthetic and gameplay improvements:

- Improved lighting and atmosphere.
- Improved animations: Jumping and Climbing.
- We changed the graffiti for posters for more coherence and integration with the city.
- Faster animation and movement on ledges.
- Improved coupling to the slingshot target.
- Added cameras and feedback decals to improve player orientation.
- Removed some invisible walls.
- We added a cinematic camera to the chase of the rat.
- We changed some cameras to improve the platforming sections.
- Small changes to puzzles for consistency.

Bug fix:

- We fixed the bug that the rat couldn't catch you in the final chase.
- We fixed that you could change the resolution in windowed mode.
- Improved the collisions in the mud section so that Victoria doesn't get stuck in the trash.

Thank you for playing Orphans and helping us to develop a better game.
